tips.title: Choose a theme first
tips.desc: Pick casual, party, cute, or bold before selecting individual pieces.

tips.title: Limit strong colors
tips.desc: One or two bright colors usually look cleaner than using every option at once.

tips.title: Balance the accessories
tips.desc: If the outfit is busy, use fewer jewelry or detail pieces.

tips.title: Try contrast
tips.desc: A simple outfit can stand out with a different hairstyle or makeup color.

tips.title: Review the full look
tips.desc: Zoom out mentally and check whether all pieces fit the same style.
